newsitem.title: USA: Archer Daniels to build plants in Iowa.
newsitem.headline: Archer Daniels to build plants in Iowa.

text.p: Archer Daniels Midland Co said Monday it will build new bioproducts manufacturing plants in Cedar Rapdis, Iowa, that will mark the company's entry into the glycerol business.
The company did not disclose the size of its investment in the new facilities. The facilities will employ 70 to 80 workers initially and 250 when a second phase is finished.

The first phase, which is scheduled to be completed by the fall of 1998, will include a glycerol plant and a lysine facility. Glycerol is a chemical widely used in food, pharmaceutical, cosmetic and industrial markets, and the plant's capacity will be 50 million pounds a year.
The lysine plant will have 100 million pounds of capacity a year, ADM said.
During the second phase of the project, ADM will add manufacturing capacity for the food additives lactic acid, citric acid and xanthan gum and the feed additives tryptophan and threonine, it said.
